questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki must train young dentists in coverage management. What is the first piece of advice he should give them?
options: Coverage management is an administrative constraint
Coverage management is a service to the patient
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: Coverage management is a service to the patient that strengthens their trust. Dr. Alami: I completely agree.

questions.question: Dr. Alami must create a training center for coverage and mutual insurance. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: The main objective is to train dentists in reimbursement management and optimizing coverage. Dr. Mabrouki: I will participate in this training.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki must evaluate the performance of a young dentist in coverage management. Which measurement is the most important?
options: The quality of information and patient orientation
The number of AMO patients treated
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: The quality of information and patient orientation is the most important measure. Dr. Alami: I agree.

questions.question: Dr. Alami must handle a crisis: a patient whose reimbursement was refused. What is the priority?
options: Listen to the patient and help them with their procedures
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: The priority is to listen to the patient and help them with their appeal procedures. Dr. Mabrouki: I will help you manage this crisis.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki must train interns in coverage risk management. What is the fundamental principle?
options: Coverage risk management is a responsibility
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: Coverage risk management is a fundamental professional responsibility. Dr. Alami: I completely agree.

questions.question: Dr. Alami must create a guide to good practices in coverage. What is the main reference?
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: Good practices should be based on Law 65-00 and national agreements. Dr. Mabrouki: I will contribute to this guide.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki must train young dentists in optimizing coverage. What is the key message?
options: Optimization is a service to the patient
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: Optimizing coverage is a service to the patient that strengthens their trust. Dr. Alami: I agree.

questions.question: Dr. Alami must create a research program in dental coverage. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: Research aims to improve coverage practices. Dr. Mabrouki: I will participate in the research.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki must manage a reference practice in coverage. What is the pillar of excellence?
options: Quality of information and patient orientation
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: Excellence is based on the quality of information and patient orientation. Dr. Alami: I agree.

questions.question: Dr. Alami must evaluate the impact of coverage on patient satisfaction. What is the role of coverage?
options: It is essential for patient satisfaction
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: Coverage is essential for patient satisfaction and trust. Dr. Mabrouki: I completely agree.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki must train interns in innovation in coverage. What current trend is important?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: Innovation concerns digitalization, teletransmission, and new forms of mutual insurance. Dr. Alami: I agree.

questions.question: Dr. Alami must create a competency evaluation system in coverage. What is the objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: Evaluation aims to improve coverage practices. Dr. Mabrouki: I will participate in the evaluation.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki must handle a conflict related to a refused reimbursement. What is the right attitude?
options: Act in accordance with the law and agreements
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: The law and agreements are the guides for resolving coverage conflicts. Dr. Alami: I agree.

questions.question: Dr. Alami must write an article on the future of dental mutual insurance. Which trend should be emphasized?
options: Mutual insurance serving access to care
The decrease in needs for mutual insurance
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: The future lies in mutual insurance serving access to care. Dr. Mabrouki: I completely agree.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki must create a quality label for coverage in practices. What are the main criteria?
options: Quality of information and patient orientation
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: Quality of information and patient orientation are the fundamental criteria. Dr. Alami: I agree.

questions.question: Dr. Alami must give a speech on the importance of mutual insurance. What message should she convey?
options: Mutual insurance is a pillar of access to care
Mutual insurance is of no interest
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: Mutual insurance is a pillar of access to care for patients. Dr. Mabrouki: I completely agree.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki must create a scholarship for students in mutual insurance management. What is the objective?
options: Encourage excellence in mutual insurance management
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: Encouraging excellence in mutual insurance management is an investment for the future. Dr. Alami: I will support this initiative.

questions.question: Dr. Alami must pass on her knowledge of coverage. What is the most effective method?
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: Personalized mentoring and case studies are the most effective methods. Dr. Mabrouki: I will get involved in mentoring.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki must create a peer network for young dentists in coverage. What is the objective?
options: Promote mutual aid and experience sharing
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: Mutual aid and sharing are essential for young dentists in coverage. Dr. Alami: I will support this network.

questions.question: Dr. Alami must write a conclusion to her work on mutual insurance. What is the final sentence?
options: Mutual insurance is the heart of access to care
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: Mutual insurance is the heart of access to care for patients. Dr. Mabrouki: I completely agree.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki must leave a legacy to the profession. What is the most beautiful legacy?
options: Skills in coverage and an example to follow
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: Skills in coverage and example are the most beautiful legacy one can leave. Dr. Alami: I completely agree.

questions.question: Dr. Alami must train future mentors in coverage. What is the first message to convey?
options: Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission
Mentoring is a source of income
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission of skills in coverage. Dr. Mabrouki: I will convey this message.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki must write a letter to future dentists about mutual insurance. What message should he convey?
options: Mutual insurance is a pillar of the patient relationship
Mutual insurance is of no interest
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: Mutual insurance is a pillar of the patient relationship. Dr. Alami: I agree.

questions.question: Dr. Alami must create an award for young dentists in coverage. What is the purpose?
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: Stimulating excellence in coverage is essential for the evolution of the profession. Dr. Mabrouki: I will support this award.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki, after a career dedicated to coverage, receives a national tribute. Dr. Alami is by his side. What is Dr. Mabrouki's message to young dentists?
options: Coverage is the heart of the patient relationship
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki concludes: Coverage is the heart of the patient relationship. It gives meaning to our practice. Dr. Alami: I am proud of you.
